notes.text: The page is headed Exercice 4.10.6. It assumes a U-site S with topology no finer than the canonical one, and an underlined class M of arrows satisfying conditions a–d: quarrability and base-change stability; identities and composition; locality on a covering family of the target; and covering refinements with arrows in M. This is an account of the source's assertions only.
notes.basis: Observation: opening and conditions a–d. No theorem verification was performed.

notes.text: The definition names S(X), double-quoted petit site de X, using the full subcategory of S/X whose structural maps lie in M and the induced topology. The source replaces the cancelled considérons le site with notons, and replaces dont la catégorie sous-jacente est with constitué par; le site is supplied in the left margin. The acute on é in considérons is visible.
notes.basis: Observation: definition and crops 04–05; the marginal insertion is observed in half a. No grammatical normalisation or proof inference.

notes.text: Question 1 asks that the indicated covering families form a pretopology generating S's topology. The epsilon-shaped sign in the indexing is transcribed as printed, without replacing it by a membership sign on mathematical grounds.

Question 2 asks for continuity of base change from S(Y) to S(X), then introduces S(u)^* between the corresponding categories of sheaves. The star and superscript tildes are pen completions. The source has the closing reference (III 1.2,iv)). with two closing parentheses.
notes.basis: Observation: question 2 and half b. The arrows and superscript positions were read from the ink, not proved correct.

notes.text: Question 3 begins an equivalence between the topos S with superscript tilde and systems (F_X), (varphi_u). It gives objects in S(X) with superscript tilde and a morphism varphi_u:S(u)^*(F_Y) to F_X. The text ends on this page at ces systèmes; no continuation has been supplied.
